column1: # nomics pipeline descriptor: nf-core/sarek 3.10.0, germline FASTQ -> VCF with
# HaplotypeCaller, configured as the goldens are (docs/VERIFY.md). Tab-separated:
# key, then values. `{prefix}` and `{lane}` are filled in by verify.
# Per platform: Nextflow profiles, then the overlay config verify adds.
# arm64 task containers, by process: the frozen Seqera Wave images the arm64
# goldens ran (tier0-wes-20261008-r1 and tier1-wes-20261008-r1 report.html list
# the same 19 processes on these 11 images), pinned by registry digest. With
# these, verify runs with Wave off and needs no network after `verify fetch`.
# Values verify takes from the reference run and passes to `nomics run`.
# A location is `root:pattern`; roots are tried in order. `work` searches
# sarek's task directories, `results` its published tree (recursively), `run`
# the nomics run directory. A name ending in `/*` is one artifact per file.
# Inputs verify refuses, with the reason it gives.
